## Goal

Update all affected documentation for the data-driven health model and the new
Harvester catalog entry.

Part of **Harvester enemy (AH-0MUI820PM0038HS2)**, feature **F7**. Covers
parent AC8. Seventh feature in the plan's dependency order (F1 → F8).

## Scope

- `docs/Game Design Document.md`:
  - §2.3 — enemy health is now data-driven; remove the "all regular enemies
    (E1–E5) are 1 HP / only the Boss is multi-hit" claim (P4 Bomb still deals
    no enemy damage).
  - §4.1 — add the new **E7 — Harvester** entry (roaming, mineral-seeking,
    `health = 5`, never fires).
  - §4.4.1 — absorption/seek wording (the Harvester actively seeks minerals).
  - §4.5 — Harvester score ≈ 400.
  - §6.5 — `Enemy.health` is no longer fixed at `1`; document the data-driven
    model.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — §1 catalog row for the Harvester,
  §8 add-an-enemy checklist/health column, and correct the "all enemies are
  1 HP" statement.
- `README.md` — enemy list includes the Harvester.

## Acceptance Criteria

- GDD §2.3, §4.1, §4.4.1, §4.5 and §6.5 reflect the data-driven health model
  and the Harvester.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` catalog/checklist are updated and
  the 1-HP claim is corrected.
- `README.md` enemy list includes the Harvester.
- Documentation-assertion tests (e.g. `src/scenes/core/gymParityDocs.test.ts`)
  pass.
- UK English throughout.
- Documentation (AC8): all related documentation is updated to reflect the
  health model and Harvester additions.

## Depends on

- F1 (health config)
- F3 (Harvester entity)
- F5 (registration/gym)
- F6 (campaign integration)

## Key Files

- `docs/Game Design Document.md`
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md`
- `README.md`
- `src/scenes/core/gymParityDocs.test.ts` (assertion reference)

## Constraints

- Documentation follows the shipped behaviour (F1–F6); do not document
  unshipped behaviour.
- UK English in all written output.

data.description:
## Goal

Extend the repo-wide parity/duplicate-body guard for the new health-finalise
and mineral-seek seams, then run the full suite and triage any failures.

Part of **Harvester enemy (AH-0MUI820PM0038HS2)**, feature **F8**. Covers
parent AC7. Final feature in the plan's dependency order (F1 → F8).

## Scope

- Extend `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts` expectations so the
  shared health-finalise and seek seams are recognised as single definitions
  (a re-introduced duplicate is detected, mirroring the existing
  `fireForEnemy` / `collectMinerals` guard entries).
- Run the full project test suite via `/skill:test` (quiet mode).
- Triage any failure into a critical `test-failure` work item per the triage
  policy (see the `triage` skill).

## Acceptance Criteria

- The guard detects a re-introduced duplicate of the health-finalise or
  mineral-seek seam.
- The full project test suite passes with all Harvester changes.
- Any failure is triaged into a critical `test-failure` work item.
- Evidence (suite result + guard output) is recorded on the parent item
  (`AH-0MUI820PM0038HS2`) — all tests must pass before the parent advances to
  `in_review`.
- Testing/validation (AC7): new unit/integration tests cover config, factory,
  seek, absorption and five-hit destruction.

## Depends on

- F1, F2, F3, F4, F5, F6, F7

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts`
- `src/test/duplicateBodyGuard.ts`
- `src/scenes/PlayScene.test.ts`
- `src/scenes/gym/GymEnemies.test.ts`

## Constraints

- Do not weaken existing guards; only add coverage for the new seams.
- Never reorder build → test → commit.
- UK English in all written output.
